CSC00004.name_vi: Nhập môn Công nghệ thông tin
CSC00004.brief: A first-year survey of how computers, programs, and networks fit together. Expect lab hours, basic terminology, and enough context to start Programming Fundamentals. Illustrative note, not the official syllabus.

CSC10012.brief: First real coding course: variables, control flow, functions, and simple data. Later courses such as CSC10004 assume you can write and debug small programs here. Illustrative note, not the official syllabus.

MTH00009.brief: Logic, sets, proofs, and counting that CS arguments rest on. Combinatorics and several programming courses reuse this language. Illustrative note, not the official syllabus.

CSC10121.brief: Presentation, teamwork, and academic communication for FIT students. Expect speaking and group work rather than a heavy coding load. Illustrative note, not the official syllabus.

CSC10004.name_vi: Cấu trúc dữ liệu và giải thuật
CSC10004.brief: Lists, stacks, trees, graphs, and the complexity of common algorithms. It sits on CSC10012 and is a gate for later core CS. Expect programming assignments, not only proofs. Illustrative note, not the official syllabus.

MTH00058.brief: Counting, recurrences, and combinatorial arguments after Discrete Mathematics. Useful when algorithms need exact counts rather than intuition. Illustrative note, not the official syllabus.

PHY00005.brief: Mechanics-style general physics used as a foundation elective in this demo. Later Physics for IT builds on it. Illustrative note, not the official syllabus.

BAA00004.brief: A general-education law course. It does not teach programming; it fills elective slots in the GEN block. Illustrative note, not the official syllabus.

CSC10003.name_vi: Phương pháp lập trình hướng đối tượng
CSC10003.brief: Classes, objects, and design habits after data structures. Several SE courses (web, Java, Windows) list it as a prerequisite. Illustrative note, not the official syllabus.

CSC10009.brief: How hardware and low-level software meet: representation, simple architecture, and system view. Networks and operating systems sit on top of it. Illustrative note, not the official syllabus.

MTH00005.brief: Limits, derivatives, and integrals at university level. Calculus 2 and probability assume this fluency. Illustrative note, not the official syllabus.

MTH00008.brief: Vectors, matrices, and linear systems. Later applied math and AI courses reuse this toolkit. Illustrative note, not the official syllabus.

CSC10014.brief: Problem decomposition and algorithm-style reasoning after programming and discrete math. Expect puzzles and structured solutions more than a single language. Illustrative note, not the official syllabus.

CSC10008.brief: Layers, addressing, and how packets move, after Computer Systems. Later SE and systems electives assume this vocabulary. Illustrative note, not the official syllabus.

MTH00006.brief: Multivariable and further calculus after Calculus 1. Keep it if you still need the GEN math spine. Illustrative note, not the official syllabus.

BAA00005.brief: A short general-education economics course. Useful as a light elective fill, not a CS core. Illustrative note, not the official syllabus.

BAA00021.brief: First PE unit in the GEN block. Physical Education 2 lists it as a prerequisite. Illustrative note, not the official syllabus.

BAA00030.brief: National defense education block. It is scheduled like other GEN courses in this demo even though the teaching format differs on campus. Illustrative note, not the official syllabus.

CSC10006.brief: Relational modeling, SQL, and why schema design matters. Web development in the SE track lists it beside OOP. Illustrative note, not the official syllabus.

CSC10007.brief: Processes, memory, and files after Computer Systems. Expect both concepts and practical exercises. Illustrative note, not the official syllabus.

MTH00007.brief: Random variables, distributions, and basic inference after Calculus 1. AI and applied math for IT list it as a prerequisite. Illustrative note, not the official syllabus.

BAA00022.brief: Second PE unit; it needs Physical Education 1. Treat it as a scheduled GEN course in the planner. Illustrative note, not the official syllabus.

PHY00007.name_vi: Vật lý cho Công nghệ thông tin
PHY00007.brief: Physics topics aimed at IT after General Physics 1. Elective in this demo GEN block. Illustrative note, not the official syllabus.

CSC14003.name_vi: Cơ sở trí tuệ nhân tạo
CSC14003.brief: Search, knowledge, and introductory AI ideas after OOP and probability. It is a GEN core course here, not a licence to quote model trivia. Illustrative note, not the official syllabus.

MTH00057.name_en: Applied Mathematics and Statistics for IT
MTH00057.name_vi: Toán ứng dụng và thống kê cho Công nghệ thông tin
MTH00057.brief: Applied linear algebra and statistics for IT problems after MTH00007 and MTH00008. Expect computation more than pure theory. Illustrative note, not the official syllabus.

BAA00003.brief: Required political theory unit in the GEN block. The planner treats it as a normal catalog row. Illustrative note, not the official syllabus.

CSC13002.name_vi: Nhập môn công nghệ phần mềm
CSC13002.brief: How teams specify, build, and check software, after OOP. Most SE-8 and SE-9 courses hang off this one. Illustrative note, not the official syllabus.

CSC13008.brief: Building web apps after OOP and databases. Expect HTTP, a backend stack, and a small project. Illustrative note, not the official syllabus.

CSC13102.brief: Application programming in Java after OOP. Useful if later mobile or Windows work needs the same object habits. Illustrative note, not the official syllabus.

BAA00101.brief: Political theory unit shared across specializations. BAA00102 lists it as a prerequisite. Illustrative note, not the official syllabus.

CSC13005.name_vi: Phân tích và quản lý yêu cầu phần mềm
CSC13005.brief: Turning stakeholder needs into managed requirements after Intro to SE. Expect documents and reviews, not only code. Illustrative note, not the official syllabus.

CSC13009.name_vi: Phát triển phần mềm cho thiết bị di động
CSC13009.brief: Mobile app construction after OOP and Intro to SE. Expect a small device-side project. Illustrative note, not the official syllabus.

CSC13001.brief: Desktop Windows programming after OOP. In the demo term it may have no offering — the engine will drop it from a plan even though this brief still describes it. Illustrative note, not the official syllabus.

CSC13010.brief: Architecture-level design after Intro to SE and OOP. Testing and architecture courses later expect this. Illustrative note, not the official syllabus.

BAA00102.name_vi: Kinh tế chính trị Mác - Lênin
BAA00102.brief: Follow-on political theory after BAA00101. Catalog row only in this planner. Illustrative note, not the official syllabus.

CSC10103.brief: Startup and product thinking near the end of the programme. Shared across specializations in this demo. Illustrative note, not the official syllabus.

CSC10107.brief: Workplace internship rather than a lecture course. The planner still treats it as a catalog course with a credit load. Illustrative note, not the official syllabus.

CSC13003.brief: Test design and quality after Intro to SE and Software Design. Expect test cases, not only running the happy path. Illustrative note, not the official syllabus.

CSC13006.name_vi: Quản lý dự án phần mềm
CSC13006.brief: Planning, tracking, and people on a software project after Intro to SE. Complements design and testing rather than replacing them. Illustrative note, not the official syllabus.

CSC13106.brief: Larger structure of systems after Intro to SE and Software Design. Expect quality attributes and trade-offs. Illustrative note, not the official syllabus.

CSC13112.brief: UI structure and interaction after Intro to SE and OOP. Complements web and mobile courses on the SE track. Illustrative note, not the official syllabus.
